## Explanations (recommended model)

- Declined test applicants: 3,314; with 4 ranked reason codes: 3,314.
- Share whose 4 reasons all push towards decline (positive SHAP): 99.5%.
- SHAP additivity check, max abs error vs raw model score: 0.00e+00.
- Scorecard points-below-max vs SHAP, on 2,591 applicants declined by both: top-1 agreement 72.8%, top-4 overlap 74.5%.
- Counterfactuals: searched 3,314, found for 99.9%; single-feature change suffices for 44.9% of those; median cost 0.64 IQR units.
